sections.A: Bunyadi usool: specificity (jo karoge wahi behtar hoga), progressive overload (load dheere dheere barhana) aur reversibility.
sections.B: FITT har exercise ke liye: aerobic hafte mein 3-5 din, strength har muscle group ke liye 2-3 din, waghaira.
sections.C: Bina machine ke load: RIR (kitne aur reps kar sakte the). Aam taur par 1-3 reps baqi hon.
sections.D: Sab sets aasaan, RIR 3 se zyada aur symptoms stable: load barhayein. Symptoms barhein: kam karein.
sections.E: Kam exercises (2-4) jo patient ke goals se judi hon, saaf likhi ya video hidayat, aur progress track karna.
sections.F: Lambe dard mein activity waqt ya quota se barhayein, dard se nahi. Graded exposure darr wali activities par kaam karta hai.
sections.G: Sawaal hal karein. RIR 2 ka matlab hai patient 2 aur reps kar sakta tha.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
